title: AdaLens: Interactive Storyline for Monitoring and Steering Long-Running Agentic Data Analysis
summary: Large language models are pushing data science toward increasingly autonomous and agentic workflows, with recent systems already supporting multi-step and long-running analyses. As these workflows become more autonomous, conventional interfaces no longer provide adequate support for two critical requirements: observability for understanding an agent's evolving reasoning and evidence, and steerability for redirecting low-value directions or deepening promising ones during execution.
